name: OpenLAM Challenges (LAM Crystal Philately)
description: Inspired by the success of Large Language Models (LLMs), the development of Large Atom Models (LAMs) has gained significant momentum in scientific computation. Since 2022, the Deep Potential team has been actively pretraining LAMs and launched the OpenLAM Initiative to develop an open-source foundation model spanning the periodic table. A core objective is establishing comprehensive benchmarks for reliable LAM evaluation, addressing limitations in existing datasets. As a first step, the LAM Crystal Philately competition has collected over 19.8 million valid structures, including 1 million on the OpenLAM convex hull, driving advancements in generative modeling and materials science applications.
evaluation_method: composite_score (combination of formation-energy RMSE, convex-hull distance, structural similarity, coverage/novelty metrics)
reputation: Emerging benchmark within the materials-science LAM community with growing adoption driven by the OpenLAM initiative.
notes: Large-scale, domain-specific benchmark focused on generative and predictive LAM tasks; potential contamination if pretrained models used OpenLAM data; evaluation uses multiple task-specific metrics rather than a single simple accuracy.
